assumptions.provenance: All operational values are constructed engineering assumptions, not measured NREL/Optimise Prime fleet records.
assumptions.operation: Small overnight delivery-van depot; required energy is dispatcher-supplied battery top-up, not target SOC.
assumptions.currency: USD demo units; synthetic rates, not a quoted utility tariff
assumptions.billing: Single overnight horizon inside October 2026 billing period. Historical peak is already established before this horizon. Only incremental EV bill is claimed; previous period energy consumption is not supplied.
assumptions.charging: Fixed AC power with a reduced final slot; one contiguous visit on one compatible charger; constant efficiency; no taper/V2G/storage.
assumptions.movement: Vehicles may wait unplugged; staff can connect/disconnect at slot boundaries. Travel/setup time is idealized to zero and staff concurrency is not modelled.
assumptions.availability: All listed chargers available for the whole horizon. Disruption fixtures are separate pre-start revisions, not mid-session recovery.
assumptions.prediction: Disabled. All listed deadlines and energy requirements are confirmed. No unplug forecast is substituted for a commitment.
